title: Forest Dragons
prompt:
Black-and-white line art children's coloring book page, classic storybook style, medium-close full-page composition with Elliott (4–5 years old, short straight light-brown hair, big gray-blue eyes, round cheeks, friendly adventurous expression, wearing medieval tunic with belt and boots or casual explorer outfit) and Colette (2–3 years old, wavy brown hair in a top knot, large gray-blue eyes, soft cheeks, wearing whimsical princess-meets-adventurer dress with floral or heart motifs) meeting a forest dragon with leaf-shaped wings and symmetrical branch-like antlers, standing protectively among oversized flowers and curling vines in a magical grove; Winnie, a small tan Chihuahua–Pug mix with upright ears and curled tail, sits near the foreground grass; characters and dragon fill about 75% of page height with large plant shapes reaching near top margin; no vine or branch intersections through faces, hands, or eyes; antlers and wings symmetrical and clearly attached; clean, medium consistent black outlines only, no shading, no gray, no gradients, no filled black areas; clear foreground, midground, background separation with outlines only; plenty of white space inside outlines for coloring; heads, hands, and feet may be near page edges; friendly, balanced proportions, expressive but restrained faces; no clutter, clear focal point on interaction between children and dragon; background supports scene but does not dominate; all characters and elements fully visible and clearly readable.

Use the attached character sheet reference images as the canonical identity and style.
